# LINK-EIM — Comprehensive Context (llms-full.txt)

> Full technical specifications, API routes, architecture diagrams, directory structure, and development guidelines for LINK-EIM at the Enterprise Infrastructure Management (EIM) Research Laboratory.

## 1. Project Overview
- **Project Name:** LINK-EIM
- **Organization:** Enterprise Infrastructure Management (EIM) Research Laboratory, Telkom University
- **Campus Location:** TULT Building 8th Floor, Room TULT.08.09, Bandung, Indonesia
- **Official Website:** https://eimlab.org
- **Repository:** https://github.com/LABEIM/LINK-EIM
- **Production URL:** https://link.eimlab.org/
- **Documentation:** https://github.com/LABEIM/LINK-EIM#readme
- **Maintainer Contact:** lab@eimlab.org

### Purpose & Scope
LINK-EIM is the official link-in-bio page for the EIM Research Laboratory at Telkom University. Rather than relying on a third-party service like Linktree, the lab hosts its own lightweight, fully self-contained hub at `link.eimlab.org`, keeping every link, asset, and visitor interaction under laboratory control with no external tracking. The page brings all of the lab's public destinations into a single, easy-to-share URL: the lab website, laboratory information, research and publications, people, news and announcements, and social/contact channels.

---

## 2. Tech Stack & System Architecture

### Technology Stack
- **Frontend Framework:** Astro 7 with TypeScript strict mode. The public page is prerendered; Keystatic admin/API routes are server-rendered through `@astrojs/cloudflare`.
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS v4 with semantic design tokens — a centered neutral card on a white canvas, ink and a single AA-safe teal accent from the emblem, solid surfaces, a drifting node network in light tones, and self-hosted Instrument Serif plus IBM Plex Sans/Mono.
- **Content Model:** Keystatic CMS with Cloud storage. Site settings (`src/content/site.yaml`) and link groups (`src/content/groups/*.yaml`) are YAML, validated and loaded at build time by `src/data/site.ts`. Site settings hold an editable lab logo (`public/images/brand/`, defaulting to the emblem), a reorderable highlighted-links list (the first renders solid, the rest on a quiet surface), and the social links list (built-in platform or custom label + optional 24×24 SVG path). Link icons come from the shared registry, a custom SVG path (`d` attribute only), an uploaded square image under `public/images/icons/`, or none. Links may carry an optional 16:9 image with alt text, a description line rendered under the label in list rows, or a `highlight` flag that renders the row with the accent treatment; groups choose a vertical `list` layout or a horizontal `scroll` layout (which requires an image on every link; the build rejects the group otherwise). The social row hides when empty.
- **Backend / API Engine:** Keystatic's generated `/api/keystatic/*` routes on Cloudflare Pages Functions.
- **Database / Storage:** None — content is committed to the GitHub repository through Keystatic Cloud's GitHub App.
- **Client JavaScript:** Small inline scripts animate the decorative node-network background on wide, pointer-capable viewports (paused for `prefers-reduced-motion` and hidden tabs), drive the horizontal scroller's overlay arrows, and open the share dialog (copy link, email, and native share are inline; WhatsApp, X, and LinkedIn sit under "More ways to share"). React loads only inside `/keystatic`.
- **Authentication:** None on the public page. `/keystatic` requires a Keystatic Cloud sign-in.
- **Hosting / Edge Platform:** Cloudflare Pages at `link.eimlab.org`; static files are served directly and `/keystatic` plus `/api/keystatic/*` run through the generated Pages Functions worker.
- **CI/CD:** LABEIM shared CI/CD (`.github/workflows/ci-cd.yml`) deploys `dist/` to the `link-eim` Cloudflare Pages project, matching `eimlab.org`.

### Architectural Overview
```
[ Visitor Browser ]                [ Lab editor ]
         │                              │
         │ public page                  │ /keystatic
         ▼                              ▼
[ Cloudflare Pages: link.eimlab.org ]
   ├── static assets   → dist/ (prerendered page + metadata)
   └── Pages Functions → dist/_worker.js
          └── /api/keystatic → Keystatic Cloud → GitHub commit (YAML)
```

---

## 3. Directory Layout & Core Files

```text
.
├── src/
│   ├── components/
│   │   ├── Icon.astro         # Inline Lucide SVG icon map
│   │   ├── LinkCard.astro     # Accessible link row or 16:9 image card
│   │   └── LinkScroller.astro # Horizontal snap-scrolling group with overlay arrows
│   ├── content/
│   │   ├── site.yaml          # Site settings singleton (Keystatic)
│   │   └── groups/*.yaml      # Link groups (Keystatic collection)
│   ├── data/
│   │   ├── site.ts            # Build-time YAML loader + validation
│   │   └── icons.ts           # Shared icon registry
│   ├── pages/
│   │   └── index.astro        # Single-page link hub
│   └── styles/
│       └── global.css         # Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui tokens
├── public/                    # Static assets and crawler/AI metadata
│   ├── assets/                # Lab emblem + favicon
│   ├── robots.txt             # Crawler guidance
│   ├── sitemap.xml            # XML sitemap
│   ├── manifest.webmanifest   # Web app manifest
│   ├── llms.txt               # AI summary
│   ├── llms-full.txt          # Full AI context (this file)
│   └── .well-known/
│       └── security.txt       # RFC 9116 security disclosure
├── astro.config.mjs           # Astro + React + Keystatic + Cloudflare adapter
├── keystatic.config.ts        # CMS schema and Keystatic Cloud project
├── .env.example               # Environment template (no secrets)
├── package.json               # Scripts and dependencies
├── tsconfig.json              # Astro strict TypeScript config
├── .github/workflows/         # CI/CD pipelines
├── AGENTS.md                  # AI coding agent workflow and rules
├── CLAUDE.md                  # Claude Code operational instructions
├── GEMINI.md                  # Gemini CLI pointer
├── CONTRIBUTING.md            # Git branch strategy & PR guidelines
├── CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md         # Community standards
├── SECURITY.md                # Vulnerability reporting SLOs
└── README.md                  # Main repository README
```

### Local Verification Commands

| Command | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- |
| `npm install` | Install dependencies |
| `npm run dev` | Dev server on `http://localhost:4321/`; CMS admin at `/keystatic` |
| `npm run build` | Production build to `dist/` (static assets + Pages Functions worker) |
| `npm run check` | Astro/TypeScript diagnostics |
| `npx wrangler pages deploy dist` | Deploy to Cloudflare Pages (requires Cloudflare credentials) |

---

## 4. Key Endpoints & Routes

| Method | Endpoint | Description | Auth Required |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :---: |
| `GET` | `/` | Primary link hub / landing page | No |
| `GET` | `/keystatic` | Keystatic CMS admin UI (not indexed) | Yes (Keystatic Cloud) |
| `*` | `/api/keystatic/*` | Keystatic content API (not indexed) | Yes |
| `GET` | `/.well-known/security.txt` | RFC 9116 security disclosure | No |
| `GET` | `/llms.txt` | Concise AI context document | No |
| `GET` | `/llms-full.txt` | Full AI context document | No |
| `GET` | `/sitemap.xml` | XML sitemap | No |

---

## 5. Developer & Agent Guidelines

- **Agent Rules:** Adhere strictly to the definitions of done, startup workflows, and tech stack constraints in [`AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/LABEIM/LINK-EIM/blob/main/AGENTS.md).
- **Contributing:** Follow conventional commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `refactor:`) and branch protection rules in [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://github.com/LABEIM/LINK-EIM/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- **Security Policy:** Report any vulnerabilities privately per [`SECURITY.md`](https://github.com/LABEIM/LINK-EIM/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
